<cite ref="Shabbat 75b:3">Sabb. 75ᵇ</cite> <he>הצָר צורה בכלי</he> he who draws a figure on a vessel.
<cite ref="Shabbat 103b:7">Ib. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>עד שיָצוּר כולו</he> until he has drawn the entire figure which he intended to draw.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 7:1">Gen. R. s. 7</cite>, beg.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 11:2">Yalk. ib. 11</cite> <he>מדת בו״ד צר צורה … יכול לצור צורה במים</he> (not <he>מלך</he>) a human being draws a design on land, can he draw a design in water?; Mekh. B’shall., Shir., s. 8.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 14:9">Lev. R. s. 14</cite> <he>לשני ציירין זה צר דמותו וכ׳</he> like two painters, one paints the likeness of one &c.; a. fr.—
